title: Estate Artifact Provenance Record
description: Lightweight schema for recording the provenance state and traceability metadata of Estate artifacts.

artifact_id.description: Stable local identifier for the artifact or provenance record.

path.description: Repository-relative path to the artifact being described.

artifact_type.description: Human-readable artifact type such as document, registry, work_package, completion_record, review_record, generated_projection, runtime_projection, asset, or other.

provenance_state.description: Current provenance state for the artifact.

created_by.description: Human, worker, role, or institution that authored or initiated the artifact.

generated_by.description: Tool, command, worker, or automation that generated the artifact.

source_inputs.description: Repository-relative paths, IDs, or descriptors for inputs used to create or generate the artifact.

reviewed_by.description: People, roles, workers, or review record IDs that reviewed the artifact.

validation_status.description: Validation posture for the artifact or provenance record.

supersedes.description: Artifact IDs or paths this artifact replaces.

superseded_by.description: Artifact IDs or paths that replace this artifact.

notes.description: Short explanatory note, limitation, or reviewer guidance.
